label: Claude Code
note: Claude Code user instructions. Cowork sessions skip global symlinks that point outside the working directory.
noteZh: Claude Code 的用户规则。Cowork 会话不会读取指向工作区外的全局软链接。

label: Codex
note: Codex user instructions. A non-empty AGENTS.override.md in CODEX_HOME replaces this file.
noteZh: Codex 的用户规则。CODEX_HOME 中非空的 AGENTS.override.md 会替代此文件。

label: Grok Build
note: Official Grok Build coding agent; not Grok web chat or third-party Grok CLI tools. Current documentation specifies no file-size cap.
noteZh: 官方 Grok Build 编程 Agent，不是 Grok 网页聊天或第三方 Grok CLI。当前官方文档已取消规则文件大小上限。

label: Gemini CLI
note: Default Gemini CLI context file. A custom context.fileName setting can change the filename the client reads.
noteZh: Gemini CLI 默认规则文件；客户端的 context.fileName 设置可能改用其他文件名。

label: Antigravity
note: Antigravity: 24,000 UTF-8 bytes per file after expanding includes; active rules also share a 20,000-token budget. Shares the default file with Gemini CLI.
noteZh: Antigravity 单文件上限为 24,000 字节（UTF-8，含展开的引用）；活跃规则另共用 20,000 token 预算。默认与 Gemini CLI 共用同一文件。

label: Devin Desktop（原 Windsurf）
note: Devin Local global rules, also read by Devin CLI. Overrides ~/.windsurf/global_rules.md; other legacy rule files remain untouched. For Cascade, use the old Windsurf entry.
noteZh: Devin Local 全局规则，Devin CLI 也会读取。优先于 ~/.windsurf/global_rules.md；其他旧规则文件保持原样。Cascade 请使用 Windsurf 旧版入口。

label: Windsurf 旧版（Cascade）
note: Global rules for Cascade in older Windsurf versions (6,000-character limit). Existing connections are preserved. For Devin Local after upgrading, use the Devin Desktop entry.
noteZh: 旧版 Windsurf 中 Cascade 的全局规则（最多 6,000 字符）。已有连接继续保留；升级后的 Devin Local 请使用 Devin Desktop 入口。

label: Cline（当前版本）
note: Global rules shared by current Cline IDE, Desktop and CLI clients. CLINE_DIR overrides the configuration root. Choose one global entry to avoid duplicate rule loading.
noteZh: 当前 Cline 编辑器扩展、桌面版和 CLI 共用的全局规则。支持 CLINE_DIR 覆盖配置目录；选择一个全局入口即可，避免重复加载。

label: Cline（Documents 规则目录）
note: Additional global rules directory still read by current Cline clients. Prefer the current-version entry for new connections; enabling both can load duplicate rules.
noteZh: 当前 Cline 仍会读取的补充全局规则目录。新接入建议选择“Cline（当前版本）”；同时启用两处可能重复加载规则。

label: Cline CLI 旧版（独立规则目录）
note: Preserves existing connections to the older CLI data/settings/rules directory. Current Cline uses rules directly under its configuration directory; use the current-version entry.
noteZh: 保留旧 CLI 在 data/settings/rules 下的规则连接。当前 Cline 改为读取配置目录下的 rules，请使用“Cline（当前版本）”。

label: Roo Code（已停止维护）
note: The original Roo Code extension shut down on May 15, 2026. This entry preserves its existing rules; it does not configure Roomote or the ZooCode fork.
noteZh: 原 Roo Code 扩展已于 2026 年 5 月 15 日停止维护。此入口保留原有规则，不配置 Roomote 或 ZooCode 分支。

label: Kilo Code（旧版 VS Code 扩展）
note: Rules for the older Kilo Code VS Code extension. Current Kilo clients use instructions in kilo.jsonc; this entry does not configure the new CLI.
noteZh: 旧版 Kilo Code VS Code 扩展的规则。当前 Kilo 客户端通过 kilo.jsonc 的 instructions 配置规则；此入口不配置新版 CLI。

label: Kiro（IDE / CLI）
note: Global steering for the local IDE and CLI. Custom agents must explicitly include steering files in their resources configuration.
noteZh: 适用于本机 IDE 和 CLI 的全局 Steering。自定义 Agent 需要在 resources 中显式引用这些文件。

label: Cursor
note: Project AGENTS.md. Global User Rules remain in Cursor Settings.
noteZh: 使用项目根 AGENTS.md；全局 User Rules 仍在 Cursor 设置中管理。

label: GitHub Copilot (IDE)
note: Repository instructions; IDE support depends on the Copilot client.
noteZh: 使用仓库级说明文件；支持范围取决于 Copilot 客户端。

label: Factory Droid
note: The total initial guideline budget is 80,000 characters, shared with other instruction files.
noteZh: 启动时的说明文件共用 80,000 字符预算，其他文件也占用该预算。

label: Augment Code / Auggie
note: User rules read by Auggie CLI and Augment IDE extensions. IDE User Guidelines are a separate setting/file; their 24,576-character limit does not describe this rules directory.
noteZh: Auggie CLI 与 Augment 编辑器扩展读取的用户规则。IDE User Guidelines 是另一项设置和文件，其 24,576 字符限制不代表此规则目录的上限。

label: Zed Agent（macOS / Linux）
note: Native Zed Agent rules on macOS/Linux. On Windows this entry preserves the older tool path; use Zed Agent (Windows) for native rules. External agents and terminal threads use their own instructions.
noteZh: macOS/Linux 的 Zed 原生规则。Windows 上此入口仅保留旧工具路径；原生规则请选择“Zed Agent（Windows）”。外部 Agent 和终端使用各自的规则入口。

label: Zed Agent（Windows）
note: Native Zed Agent rules at %APPDATA%/Zed/AGENTS.md. Falls back to ~/AppData/Roaming/Zed/AGENTS.md when APPDATA is missing or invalid. Connect separately from the older .config path; existing files require confirmed backup takeover.
noteZh: Windows 原生 Zed Agent 规则，位于 %APPDATA%/Zed/AGENTS.md。APPDATA 缺失或无效时使用 ~/AppData/Roaming/Zed/AGENTS.md。与旧 .config 路径单独接入；已有文件须确认备份接管。

label: Junie（JetBrains 插件）
note: JetBrains plugin rules. When .junie/AGENTS.md exists it replaces the default root rules and playbook/rules combination; a custom Guidelines path takes precedence.
noteZh: JetBrains 插件的项目规则。存在 .junie/AGENTS.md 时，不再组合读取根 AGENTS.md、playbook 和 rules；自定义 Guidelines path 优先。
